dedupe_keys.name: 下水道事業会計 sewerage and wastewater

description: 下水道事業会計 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 狛江市. 令和５年度「統計こまえ」に掲載された下水道事業会計です。 （注意事項） 公共下水道特別会計は、令和２年度から地方公営企業法の一部適用により下水道事業会計として、公営企業会計へ移行. Coverage: 狛江市. The portal files it under the publisher 狛江市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
